results.name: registration_0_of_3_sp_success
results.recovery_action: Keep pending and retry Storage Provider writes. Do not show final success.
results.atomicity_note: The LS succeeded, but fewer than threshold SPs succeeded.

results.name: registration_1_of_3_sp_success
results.recovery_action: Keep pending and retry Storage Provider writes. Do not show final success.
results.atomicity_note: The LS succeeded, but fewer than threshold SPs succeeded.

results.name: registration_2_of_3_sp_success
results.recovery_action: Show success only as threshold-committed. Reconcile missing Storage Providers in the background.
results.atomicity_note: The operation is recoverable with 2/3 SPs, but not fully replicated.

results.name: process_death_before_ls_submission
results.recovery_action: No external Login Server effect exists yet. The client can cancel or restart the operation from the journal.
results.atomicity_note: No distributed atomicity problem yet because no external side effect has happened.

results.name: process_death_after_ls_submission_timeout
results.recovery_action: The client cannot know whether the Login Server applied the request. Keep the pending operation and require LS status/idempotency API or manual confirmation.
results.atomicity_note: This cannot be made atomic with an unmodified Login Server.

results.name: process_death_before_sp_commit
results.recovery_action: Retry Storage Provider writes using the same operation ID. Do not show final success until the SP threshold is reached.
results.atomicity_note: The LS may already be updated while SP state is missing, so rollback is not reliable.

results.name: process_death_after_partial_sp_commit
results.recovery_action: Keep pending and retry Storage Provider writes. Do not show final success.
results.atomicity_note: The LS succeeded, but fewer than threshold SPs succeeded.

results.name: partial_master_password_update_2_of_3
results.recovery_action: Allow recovery only with version checks. Reconcile missing Storage Providers before relying on the new version everywhere.
results.atomicity_note: Partial master-password updates are dangerous because SPs may hold different versions.

results.name: partial_master_password_update_1_of_3
results.recovery_action: Keep pending. Do not consider the master-password update durable. Retry or require manual recovery.
results.atomicity_note: Less than threshold success means the new state is not safely recoverable.

results.name: login_server_timeout_after_submission
results.recovery_action: Keep pending. Without an LS status or idempotency API, the client cannot know whether the LS applied the operation.
results.atomicity_note: Timeout after submission is not distinguishable from success with lost response.

results.name: divergent_cid_values
results.recovery_action: Do not treat the state as fully healthy. Compare versions/cid values, select the newest valid threshold state, and reconcile divergent Storage Providers.
results.atomicity_note: All Storage Providers may respond successfully while still holding divergent cid/version values. Success count alone is not enough.
